subject: Yinguissa invited you to Yinguissa/Maritime_Verification_Engine
body:
@Yinguissa has invited you to collaborate on the Yinguissa/Maritime_Verification_Engine repository.


Visit https://github.com/Yinguissa/Maritime_Verification_Engine/invitations to accept or decline this invitation.

You can also head over to https://github.com/Yinguissa/Maritime_Verification_Engine to check out the repository or visit https://github.com/Yinguissa to learn a bit more about @Yinguissa.

This invitation will expire in 7 days.

Some helpful tips:
- If you get a 404 page, make sure you’re signed in as Mahiamk.
- Too many emails from @Yinguissa? You can block them by visiting
  https://github.com/settings/blocked_users?block_user=Yinguissa or report abuse at
  https://github.com/contact/report-abuse?report=Yinguissa
